On every connected simple undirected unweighted graph G, the polynomial q_h(s)=1+hs+h^2s^2/2+h^3s^3/6 is positive on s>=0, so R=q_h(L)^{-1} is symmetric SPD with eigenvalues in (0,1], diagonal entries positive, R1=1 and Euclidean contraction. Off-diagonal positivity reduces exactly to positivity of the transposed cofactors of A(h)=6I+6hL+3h^2L^2+h^3L^3, since det A>0. I independently enumerated the entire connected graph-atlas list n=2..6 (counts 1,2,6,21,112), computed all 1,933 unordered-pair cofactor polynomials in exact SymPy integer arithmetic and certified a nonnegative nonzero coefficient vector immediately in 1,932 cases and after multiplication by (1+h)^32 in the remaining case. This exhausts graph order <=6, not a timestep sample. An independent exact 7x7 rational P7 inverse verifies endpoint (1,7) entries at h=1/2,3/4,1,2 as 1036685/130532396219, -529900671519/16012967110980391, -16229/1505893633, and 96462616/19528273141. The complete matrices at 1/2 and 2 are strictly positive, proving reentry. No weighted/directed conclusion follows.
